headline: Mistakes People Make After a Garage Fire
articleBody: A garage fire can be super disruptive, and in the aftermath, it's easy to make a few common mistakes that can actually worsen the damage or slow down recovery. First off, a big one is entering the garage too soon without a safety check. Always ensure the structure is stable and there are no hidden hot spots or electrical hazards before stepping inside. Another mistake is trying to clean soot with household cleaners. Soot from a fire is often oily and acidic; improper cleaning can smear it into surfaces, making it harder to remove and potentially causing permanent staining or etching. Don't delay contacting your insurance company either; quick notification is key to starting your claim process smoothly. Neglecting to ventilate the area is another misstep; smoke odors can quickly permeate your entire home if not properly contained and aired out. And finally, underestimating the extent of the damage is common. Smoke and heat can damage items and structures you might not immediately notice.
